$description: Element + inline-script allowlist for `revkit check-dist`. The tool is an allowlist, not a denylist: only what appears here is emitted by the current Starlight / Astro / KaTeX / Vega-Lite build. Regenerate `sha256` after an upgrade with `bun packages/cli/bin/revkit.js check-dist --print-hashes site/dist` and hand-inspect the diff — a hash change is a signal a vendored inline script moved. Add a new element only after checking what emits it and confirming the emitted attributes are on the per-element allowlist below (or in the global set).
$comment_globalAttrs: Attribute names allowed on ANY element (structural / ARIA / data / hidden). Everything else is per-element or refused.
$comment_perElement: Per-element attribute allowlist, and, per-element allowed values for specific attributes. `svg` and SVG child elements defer to the sanitiser's SVG allowlist (imported from site/src/lib/render-plot.ts). MathML elements listed here are exactly those the KaTeX build emits.

img.$comment: Not emitted by the current build (Starlight uses inline SVG icons only) but permitted for future content — data: URL exception is enforced in code (data:image/… only).

script.$comment: Inline <script> allowed only when its SHA-256 is in `sha256` below; <script src> allowed only when src starts with `/_astro/`. Enforcement is in code, not JSON.

template.$comment: Starlight uses <template id=…> for lazy structure; content is inert until cloned. Allowed empty of active content — id comes from globalAttrs.

$comment_customElements: Starlight ships custom elements (`<sl-…>`, `starlight-…`, `mobile-starlight-toc`, `site-search`). Any tag containing a hyphen is a custom element per the HTML spec; allowlist by exact tag name here and the attribute set they carry.
$comment_svgFallback: SVG root and every SVG child element defer to site/src/lib/render-plot.ts's ALLOWED_SVG_ELEMENTS + ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES — the same sanitiser used at build. Nothing else is duplicated here.
$comment_refusedByName: Element names explicitly refused even if a future Starlight upgrade emits them — a browser-attack-surface anchor. `template` is NOT on this list because Starlight currently emits it (see per-element note); `math` is NOT on this list because KaTeX emits it, but the allowed MathML children are enumerated in `elements` above.
$comment_sha256: SHA-256 hex of every inline <script> the current build emits. A hash mismatch fails the guard. Each key names the feature the script belongs to so a maintainer reviewing an upgrade diff can tell what moved.
